name: dumbbell
title: Dumbbell plot
description: One row per record with a dot for each side on a shared scale. The bar between the dots is the gap, in the colour of the side that is higher.
needs: A numeric measure. Reads best with up to a few hundred records; group them with `group`.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Each {unitOne} has two dots on one scale: {leftShort} and {rightShort}. When they agree there is one grey dot. When they differ, the bar between them is the gap, in the colour of the side that is higher.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: Row order within each group: as sent, or largest difference first.

options.name: maxRows
options.description: Draw at most this many records.
